channel.title: McCal Media Blog
channel.description: Field notes, visual essays, and reporting from McCal Media.

item.title: Three Days in Boyd Station
item.description: A few days in Boyd Station, Kentucky, reveal a place shaped by meadows, repair work, porch light, and the easy patience of people who do not need to announce themselves.
item.author: Caleb McCartney

item.title: The Capitalist Contradiction
item.description: A look at how late capitalism repackages control as freedom, style, and self-invention.
item.author: Caleb McCartney

item.title: Player One
item.description: A memory of being handed a controller becomes an essay about pressure, control, and the simple moments that still cut through the noise.
item.author: Caleb McCartney

item.title: In the Shadow of Loss
item.description: After several deaths in quick succession, grief stopped arriving as a single event and became the atmosphere around everything else.
item.author: Caleb McCartney
